nodes.title: Encuesta Continua de Hogares (ECH) / Continuous Household Survey
nodes.description: Continuous household survey that is the primary source for labour-market indicators, household income, and income-based poverty and inequality measurement. National coverage with Montevideo / Interior domains.

nodes.title: Pobreza por el método del ingreso / Income poverty
nodes.description: Official income-poverty and indigency incidence, calculated by comparing household income (from ECH) with nationally defined poverty and indigency lines. Published with Montevideo / Interior and other breakdowns.

nodes.title: Líneas de pobreza e indigencia
nodes.description: Monetary values of the poverty and indigency lines (per capita / household), differentiated for Montevideo and the Interior and updated with price information.

nodes.title: Índice de Precios al Consumo (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
nodes.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services.

nodes.title: Censo de Población y Vivienda / Population and Housing Census
nodes.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline and sampling frames for household surveys.

nodes.title: Índice de Pobreza Multidimensional (IPM)
nodes.description: Official multidimensional poverty index capturing deprivations across multiple dimensions beyond income. Complements the income-poverty series.

nodes.title: Índice de Volumen Físico de la Industria Manufacturera (IVFIM)
nodes.description: Monthly physical-volume index of manufacturing production. Principal high-frequency industrial-activity indicator.

nodes.title: Encuesta Anual de Actividad Económica (EAAE)
nodes.description: Annual structural business survey covering value added, employment, investment and other variables across economic activities.

nodes.title: Montevideo — capital statistical identity
nodes.description: Capital city and primary urban economy. Core domain for ECH labour, income and poverty analysis. Higher average incomes than the Interior but also elevated poverty incidence in peripheral areas.

nodes.title: Departamento de Artigas — high-poverty border contrast
nodes.description: Northern border department with among the highest poverty incidence in the 2025 departmental results.

nodes.title: Departamento de Rivera — high-poverty border contrast
nodes.description: Northern border department with elevated poverty incidence. Completes the northern border contrast set.

nodes.title: Departamento de Cerro Largo — high-poverty border contrast
nodes.description: Northeastern border department with elevated poverty incidence.

nodes.title: Departamento de Colonia — low-poverty contrast
nodes.description: Southern department with among the lowest poverty incidence in the 2025 results.

nodes.title: Pobreza por departamento (INE)
nodes.description: Official departmental tabulations of income poverty. Primary source for the inter-departmental poverty gradient.

nodes.title: Departamento de Maldonado — low-poverty southern contrast
nodes.description: Southern coastal department with among the lowest poverty incidence. Completes the low-poverty southern set alongside Colonia.

nodes.title: Departamento de Canelones — core metropolitan periphery
nodes.description: Large department surrounding Montevideo. Intermediate poverty and inequality; important demographic and economic weight in the greater capital region.

nodes.title: Coeficiente de Gini / Income inequality
nodes.description: Official Gini coefficient of income inequality, calculated from ECH income data. Published nationally and by department.

nodes.title: Indicadores de empleo y desempleo (ECH)
nodes.description: Labour-force indicators from the ECH: employment rate, unemployment rate, activity rate, and related quality-of-employment measures.

nodes.title: Actividad de la construcción / Construction activity
nodes.description: Statistics of construction activity, employment and related permits. Cyclically sensitive sector tracked via employment, permits and investment indicators.

nodes.title: Departamento de Flores — low-poverty interior contrast
nodes.description: Small interior department with among the lowest poverty and inequality incidence.

nodes.title: Departamento de Salto — northern interior
nodes.description: Northern interior department with elevated inequality and intermediate-to-higher poverty relative to the southern core.

nodes.title: Presupuesto Nacional / National Budget
nodes.description: Annual national budget law and subsequent execution reports covering revenues and expenditure of the central government.

nodes.title: Gasto público en educación y salud
nodes.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas / INE
nodes.description: Public expenditure on education and health as reflected in the national budget and related functional statistics. Complements household-survey education and health modules.

nodes.title: Deuda pública / Public debt statistics
nodes.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas / BCU
nodes.description: Stock and flow statistics of central-government and public-sector debt (external and domestic). Key sustainability indicator.

nodes.title: Régimen de Zonas Francas
nodes.publisher: Dirección Nacional de Zonas Francas / MEF
nodes.description: Free-zone regime offering tax and customs incentives for industrial, commercial and services activities. Strategic instrument for logistics, manufacturing and global-services investment.

nodes.title: Ley de Promoción de Inversiones / COMAP regime
nodes.description: General investment-promotion regime granting tax benefits (IRAE, wealth tax, import duties, VAT credits) for declared investment projects. Administered through COMAP.

nodes.title: Relación comercial y estratégica con China
nodes.description: Strategic partnership and intensive bilateral trade relationship with China (top export destination). Includes dairy-protocol and broader economic cooperation; FTA negotiations and RCEP interest under discussion.
